lines.text: Sam plants his pole on a muddy switchback, pulls it out, and the rubber tip is gone.
Rubber caps are made for pavement, rock slabs and boardwalks.
On mud, snow and loose dirt they slip and get sucked off.
Pull the caps off at the trailhead, keep them in a pocket, and let the bare metal tip bite in.
Sam's pole grips every step down.
Save this before your next muddy hike.
